correctness.rationale: Henson universality and homogeneity identify complete ordered two-types with K4-free finite extensions. A complete case split on the new edge yields \(F(G)^2+Q(G)\). With bipartite parameters the overlap is independent, giving \(4^n+3^n I_G(1/3)\). Clone replacement yields n+1 distinct exact rational interpolation nodes and polynomial-size bipartite oracle inputs, proving exact #P-hardness by #BIS; nondeterministic adjacency-diagram guesses establish membership. The self-contained integer/rational checker compares direct K4-free diagrams, weighted independent sets, and interpolation on 75, 52, and 51 configurations. Finite checks supplement rather than replace proof.

value.rationale: On bipartite parameter graphs, all nonalgebraic H4 one-types are trivially \(2^n\), yet pair-type enumeration exactly encodes a nontrivial hard-core partition function and is #P-complete. This yields a motivated arity-sensitive complexity transition in finite-parameter type spaces and a general exact extension formula, not a routine substitution or arbitrary finite invariant.
